result.title: A Geometric Invariant of Attention Predicts Head Specialization from Weights Alone
result.comment: Accepted as an extended abstract at the Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations Workshop (NeurReps), NeurIPS 2026
result.summary: Transformers are built with continuous symmetries in the attention mechanism. We derive $ρ$, a scalar invariant that measures each head's capacity to couple to rotary positional encodings. This framework allows us to analyze heads without forward passes, opening a new research direction into data-independent analysis of modern LLMs. Empirically, we find that $ρ$ predicts induction heads, the most-studied circuit type in mechanistic interpretability, with Spearman correlation between $-0.55$ and $-0.74$ across four bias-free RoPE models spanning $135$M to $7$B parameters. As a preliminary proof of concept, we use $ρ$ to apply YaRN to only the top-50% positional heads, which degrades perplexity less than uniform application. Code is available at https://github.com/MPedraBento/rho-invariant.

AI.brief_summary: 论文从注意力机制的连续对称性推导出标量不变量 ρ，用于衡量各注意力头与 RoPE 的耦合能力，并在多个无偏置 RoPE 模型上检验其与 induction head 的相关性，还尝试据此选择性地应用 YaRN。
AI.relevance_reason: 不直接研究 LVR，但提供了仅凭权重刻画注意力头位置特化的线索；可供核查 ρ 能否用于区分 VLM 中的位置头与内容头，从而分析 latent 相似度中的位置、注意力结构效应及选择性位置干预。
